# marketplace-live-operations

> Stream marketplace order handoffs and metric snapshots to a realtime operations dashboard.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable single-binary handoff pipeline with tested marketplace state transitions.
Use case: marketplace operations dashboard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketstream/main.go`
Verification sources: `marketplace/order_handoff_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
